g.text: Attention(Q, K, V) = softmax( Q · KT / √dk ) · V = Z
STEP-BY-STEP VECTOR WALKTHROUGH // FOCUSED ON TOKEN t₂: "model"
Row vector q₂ is multiplied by each key vector to quantify relational compatibility:
Geometric Intuition: When query and key vectors point in similar directions in latent space, their dot product is maximized.
Dividing by √d_k (√4 = 2) prevents exploding gradients, then softmax produces a strict probability distribution:
Token 2 concentrates almost half its entire attention capacity on "learns"!
Key Property: The exponentiation emphasizes top contenders while non-linearly suppressing lower similarity scores.
3. Linear Combination of Value Vectors: z₂ = ∑ α₂,ⱼ · vⱼ
The attention probabilities serve as mixing weights, blending features from all three tokens' value representations:
Value Routing: Values hold the content payload; attention weights act as dynamic content routing valves.
The isolated word "model" has now absorbed its linguistic context and role in the sentence:
• 47% infused by what it is doing ("learns")
Done! Every token in the sequence now possesses global contextual awareness from a single attention pass.
Query-Key Dot Product: Computing Token Similarity
Every token emits a Query vector (Q) representing what information it is looking for, and a Key vector (K) describing what information it holds.
Taking the dot product Q · Kᵀ evaluates the pairwise affinity between every token pair in parallel, creating the raw unnormalized score matrix S.
Matrix dimensions: (N × d_k) × (d_k × N) → (N × N) affinity grid.
Scale & Softmax: Converting Logits to Probabilities
Raw scores are scaled by 1/√d_k to prevent dot products from growing excessively large for large dimensions, which would cause vanishing gradients.
Applying row-wise Softmax exponentiates each score and normalizes it so every row sums to exactly 1.0. This yields the Attention Weight Matrix (A).
Value Weighting: Extracting Relevant Semantic Content
The Value vector (V) contains the actual substantive content of each token. The computed attention weights act as blending percentages.
Multiplying A · V computes a weighted average of all values: high-attention tokens inject their features heavily, while low-attention tokens are filtered out.
Matrix dimensions: (N × N) × (N × d_v) → (N × d_v) contextual representations.
Contextual Output Matrix (Z): Complete Global Synthesis
The final matrix Z represents each token with all surrounding context already seamlessly integrated in a single forward operation.
Unlike sequential RNNs or LSTMs, attention has an effective path length of O(1) between any two arbitrary tokens regardless of their distance in the sentence.
Output matrix Z is passed forward into the Feed-Forward Network (FFN) and subsequent Transformer layers.
